subject: Milestone certification & exit tests orchestration
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@healthbridge.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@veridian.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Milestone certification: proposed exit tests & handover playbook

Hi Aisha / Samir —

Following our discovery last week, attached is a proposed lightweight MAP that focuses on how we will certify each milestone during the evaluation and what counts as evidence for handover. High level:

- Milestone 1 — Staging smoke & integration: connectivity, basic inference correctness, and end-to-end call paths. Exit gate: all smoke tests pass on a sustained 1-hour run, and CI artifacts (health checks + logs) are captured.
- Milestone 2 — Performance & SLOs: latency targets, throughput under expected concurrency, and KV cache behavior. Exit gate: 99th percentile latency ≤ 220ms for 90% of samples during a 2-hour load window.
- Milestone 3 — Clinical concordance & safety: domain-specific accuracy threshold (concordance to human review), hallucination sampling, and edge-case logging. Exit gate: concordance ≥ 92% on curated test set + no critical safety failures in logs.

I attached a draft spreadsheet (MAP_v0.1.xlsx) and a short acceptance-tests.md that enumerates the test cases and required artifacts per gate. Items I need from you to finalize:
1) Confirmation of test owners (engineering, security, clinical SME).
2) Any additional evidence items you require (audit logs, SOC2 snippets, demo scripts).
3) Target close date for the evaluation so we can time the canary and cutover.

If that looks reasonable I'll push an updated version by EOD with explicit test owners and dates. Would you be open to a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through the acceptance-tests?

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
(Attachment: MAP_v0.1.xlsx, acceptance-tests.md)

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@healthbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@veridian.io>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Milestone certification: proposed exit tests & handover playbook

Thanks Hannah — this is helpful. A few quick notes: 

- Overall framework looks good. We do need security/compliance evidence for Milestone 2 and 3: specifically, a sample of audit logs (redacted ok), a SOC 2 summary page, and confirmation of encryption-at-rest keys.
- For clinical concordance we'll own the human-review pass/fail but want the test harness to export a per-case trace that includes model prompt, response, and any post-processing.
- Please include a data residency acceptance gate (we require EU-data-at-rest to remain in EU regions for any EU patient test data).

Samir — looping you to confirm your infra contact so we can coordinate the load window.

Happy to take a 30-min call tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Aisha

Appreciate the quick review, Aisha — good call on the compliance artifacts. I've updated the MAP (MAP_v0.2.xlsx) and inlined the acceptance criteria below for visibility. Updated items: added Security evidence column and a Data Residency gate for EU.

Inline summary of acceptance-tests (short-form):
- Staging smoke (owner: HealthBridge Eng + Redwood AM): run smoke suite 3x, collect health-checks + stack traces, evidence: smoke_report.json + logs.tar.gz
- Performance SLO (owner: Ben Carter, Redwood Eng): 2-hour load window, p95/p99 targets, evidence: k6-report.html, p99_latency.csv, infra-metrics.zip; pass if p99 ≤ 220ms on baseline set.
- Clinical concordance (owner: HealthBridge Clinical SME): evaluate curated set (n=1,000); evidence: concordance_report.csv, 3 sampled case studies with reviewer notes; pass if concordance ≥ 92%.
- Security/compliance (owner: HealthBridge Security + Redwood Security): provide SOC2 summary + sample audit logs; pass after artifacts accepted and no open critical findings.

Proposed timeline (draft):
- Kickoff & baseline (week 0) — baseline data & traces collected
- Milestone 1 — week 1
- Milestone 2 — week 2 (load window planned for Thursday)
- Milestone 3 — week 3

Can you confirm the week-2 load window preference (Thu 06/17 or Fri 06/18) and who will be our infra contact for coordinating the load run? Ben — assigning you the perf SLO owner item; please add measurable test vectors and any warmup steps you want us to do.

I'll also push the MAP to the Drive link and update the HubSpot record.

Thanks,
Hannah

(Attachment: MAP_v0.2.xlsx)

Looping in from ops perspective — quick run-through: 
- LGTM on the three-milestone split.
- Suggestion: swap who collects smoke_report.json vs logs.tar.gz so HealthBridge owns the smoke artifacts and Redwood owns the infra metrics; reduces ambiguity during handoff.
- Requesting we add a short rollback/escape hatch procedure to the MAP (one-paragraph) so the procurement team has a clear cutover fallback. I can draft that and push to the Drive.

Hannah: can we firm the proposed dates? If week-2 load will be the 17th, we should lock the baseline collection window for 06/10–06/12 so engineering has time to reproduce.
